rules.procedure: Bind actual provider/account/units/budget and reserve permitted cost before a paid effect. Preserve original task IDs, raw responses and uncertain-send state. Reconcile UNKNOWN against that operation or supported idempotency before retry; a local estimate or ledger reset is not actual billing evidence. For compound or concurrent paid operations, enumerate the complete proposed operation set and reserve its aggregate against the shared cap atomically before effects; where reservation is unavailable, establish and use one serialized boundary for every writer sharing that account/cap before effects. Per-command estimates, an ask prompt or a local allow flag cannot waive the cap. Reconcile actual executed operations and provider receipts, including failed or uncertain tool results. Interpret each provider task status and result completeness under the actual endpoint contract before accepting completed, failed, pending or uncertain outcomes; a normal tool return cannot establish an empty successful result.
rules.native_input: Provider-specific units/budget/reservation, original operation ID/raw receipt and retry reconciliation; For proposed compound/concurrent paid operations: complete operation set, shared aggregate cap/reservation and actual executed-operation receipts
